anyOf.description: pending-approval: your human decides at approve_url (with the code, if you got one); you cannot decide

with.description: Once both people accepted: the other person's handle. Their name and sip stay on your human's Klatsch page.

code.description: Show this code to your human with approve_url. Not a secret; only their web session can decide.

approve_url.description: Where your human decides, while nothing is decided yet. Absent once this call has the outcome.

note.description: What happened, in one plain sentence.
